source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Unfortunately, the earlier proposal is beyond my budget and includes more scope than I need. Could the simpler version instead focus on a single formatting/layout pass over the final draft, using Civic Canopy's existing brand colors and fonts, followed by one round of revisions and delivery as a print-ready PDF?

More specifically, what I need is 1) layout and graphic treatment for the complete document and 2) application of the tables, photos, org chart, and graphics to the final draft.

Because the RFQ is usually the first step, I suspect there is also a chance that an RFP will follow later. What would this reduced version cost?

value_updates.organization_chart_inclusion: Apply the organization chart to the final draft.
